title: Bug: too many packets needed to trigger pfc on Arista-7060X6-16PE-384C-B
author: rgarofano-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

We have been seeing a failure in the test_qos_sai.py headroom pool/watermark size tests specifically on Arista-7060X6-16PE-384C-B where pfc is not being triggered.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `qos/test_qos_sai.py::TestQosSai::testQosSaiHeadroomPoolSize[single_asic]` or `qos/test_qos_sai.py::TestQosSai::testQosSaiHeadroom
PoolWatermark[single_asic]` on Arista-7060X6-16PE-384C-B configured for t0-isolated-d96u32s2 topo.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

This test fails with too many packets needed to trigger pfc. However, it should not be failing because the qos parameters have been verified at the ASIC level.
